533:t_011:3.en:
$$スザク$$
「Maybe it's because of $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$'s song.」

533:t_011:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units! We go on the offensive here, all at once!」

533:t_011:6.en:
$$オズマ$$
「We'll take on the Empire and $$マーティアル$$ both at once! Bomber!!」

533:t_011:7.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Let's go, you guys! Every last one of you, listen to my song!!」

533:t_012:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「I'm nowhere near done singing yet!」

533:t_013:0.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「The enemy's all wiped out, and he's still singing...」

533:t_013:1.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Bottomless energy. That's $$熱気バサラ$$ for you.」

533:t_013:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It isn't only $$バサラ$$. All of us hold infinite power within.」

533:t_013:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That is what will lead us to an infinite future.」

533:t_013:4.en:
$$桂$$
「Infinite power and an infinite future... Not a bad phrase.」

533:t_013:5.en:
$$オルソン$$
「At the very least, I would rather hope for that than for the future the $$集合無意識$$ showed us.」

533:t_013:6.en:
$$レド$$
「So everyone was shown the future in those ruins too, after all...」

533:t_013:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I will tell you about that myself.」

533:t_013:9.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Heh... It seems there was a reason to come here after all...」

533:t_014:0.en:
$$尸刻$$
「The heat of life... I understand, just a little, what my brother is trying to do...」

533:t_014:1.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Thank you, $c. But be prepared: there will not be a next time.」

533:t_015:0.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$尸刻$$ of the $$鬼宿$$, huh...」

533:t_015:1.en:
$$カナリア$$
「It seems that woman, unlike $$バサラ$$, can steal the power of life by singing.」

533:t_015:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So that's the $$鬼宿$$, who make the force of scattering life their own power...」

533:t_016:0.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Did $$マーティアル$$ come here to destroy the ruins...?」

533:t_016:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Even so, showing up right when we're here is just too good a timing.」

533:t_016:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We should assume there is some intent behind this.」

533:t_100:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(I have no more hesitation...! Whatever the enemy, I will only move forward!)

533:t_100:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(Watch, $$シャルル・ジ・ブリタニア$$! I am $$ゼロ$$...! The man who works miracles!)

533:t_101:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
(And now he means to warp our fates again...)

533:t_102:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「You sing too! Burn your soul!」

533:t_102:1.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Our songs are different from yours.」

533:t_102:2.en:
$$尸刻$$
「But... I do not dislike your song.」

533:t_103:0.en:
$n
($$アドヴェント#pilot$$... Why did he show himself to us...)

533:t_103:1.en:
$n
(I don't understand... Not $$アドヴェント#pilot$$... and not $$マキ#pilot$$...)
